44f11e57668161ba.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — President Donald Trump s trip to New York for a speech at the United Nations started Monday with a detour to Gracie Mansion for an hourlong chat — and a trip down memory lane — with Mayor Zohran Mamdani. The president, appearing with Mamdani after their meeting , reminisced about his previous visits to the official residence of the city s mayors and recalled great ones and some not so great ones who have led the city in the past.
